query: Build me a 90-day drip campaign for seller follow-ups. I want SMS, email, and phone call touches automated through n8n.
expected_behavior: Provides complete 90-day touch schedule with specific day numbers
Maps each touch to channel: SMS, email, or phone call
Shows n8n workflow architecture: Schedule trigger → Query CRM → Determine touch → Execute → Log
Includes compliance checks before each outreach (DNC, hours, frequency)
Mentions speed-to-lead protocol for Day 0 (under 5 minutes)
References SMS and email templates from OUTREACH_SCRIPTS.md
Includes re-engagement escalation when seller responds
Shows touch schedule code for n8n implementation
